name: Nedbank Group Limited
note: South African banking group with its primary listing on the JSE (2025 Integrated Report). Its largest shareholder at December 2025 was the Public Investment Corporation (SA) at 14.9% (2025 Integrated Report, 'Our top 10 shareholders' table, page 75); Old Mutual held a 19.9% minority stake through Old Mutual Life Assurance Company South Africa Limited (OMLACSA) as stated for the 2018 unbundling, its current size not separately sourced (Old Mutual does not appear in the group's December 2025 top-10 shareholder table).
